digest.component_or_area: legacy-store project mapping migration via ensure units
propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project field on tickets, causing every ticket to resolve to absent-project with no recorded legacy default after upgrade
Migration must seed the projects mapping with legacy_default from Backend.project and mark multi-project-bridge capability only when mapping contains multiple projects
Ensure units must write zero ticket events to avoid four-figure event writes under store lock and silent skips during MCP boot with contended locks
Both ensure units (projects-seed and projects-compat-stamp) must be idempotent check-then-act operations that converge on init, re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot without operator action
A two-project mapped store must add multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities while a one-project store remains unstamped for older binary compatibility
Convergence property: second sweep returns ok for both units and leaves tickets-branch tip SHA unchanged; zero ticket events distinguishes from EDIT-per-ticket migration
